lines.zh: 我小步挪动，眼睛不离开你
lines.en: I shuffle along, eyes fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，尽量不出声
lines.en: I keep low and quiet on the ground.
My breathing is louder than my steps.
I pace around the arena, step by step.
I drift to the wall for cover.

lines.zh: 我的脚很小，步子却很沉
lines.en: Small feet, but heavy steps.
I creep closer, then stop.
I step around the broken bricks.
I walk and measure the distance.
I wipe my face and keep moving.
I have shifted to your flank.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上一跳一跳
lines.en: My shadow hops along the wall.
I stand, fingers moving.
I count the seconds in my head.
This place is too open.
I pant harder than anyone.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，眼睛还在转
lines.en: I hold still, but my eyes keep moving.
I raise a hand into a pose.
I am deciding which move to lead with.
My belly rises and falls.
I have been staring at you a while.
I clear my throat.
I scratch the back of my neck.
I am waiting for you to blink.

lines.zh: 我缩了缩脖子，又挺起来
lines.en: I hunch, then straighten up.
I give a thin, ugly laugh.
Hold still and let me look.
Your ki is not very strong.
I will count to three, and you are done.
Your shoulders are too stiff.

lines.zh: 我一直在看你，你没发现
lines.en: I have been watching you all along.
How many did you bring?
I laugh because you are slow.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听得见
lines.en: Your breathing is ragged, and I can hear it.
I reach out, and you flinch.
Your soles are scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 我好几年没见过新对手了
lines.en: I have not seen a new opponent in years.
You carry the smell of ki.
Do not leave me your back.
I am watching your wrists.
You strike first; I will be generous.
Stand there, I am coming.
I slowly raise my eyelids.
It hurts; I am not used to being hit.
I pull back and guard my side.
My breathing is even harsher.

lines.zh: 我缩了缩，眼睛却没移开
lines.en: I flinch, but my eyes do not leave you.
My ki is knocked loose.
I clamp my jaw tight.
Do not think that means you won.
Both my legs are still under me.
Food? I have no time for that.
Why are you holding it up there?
Food is useless at a time like this.
I am not picky, but I am not stupid.
Put it down and I will pretend I saw nothing.
My stomach is a bit empty.
That trick is old.
You want to trade food for your life?
That will not fill a tooth gap.
You hit me, back off.
This bulk is not soft.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我出手没分寸
lines.en: Do not crowd me, I pull no punches.
I drop my shoulder and shove back.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚了，时间会停一下。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot; time will pause.
I rock, then steady.
Lucky that was only a bump.

lines.zh: 我的鞋底在地上滑了半尺
lines.en: My soles slide half a foot.
We part and each take a step.
Do not touch me, my skin is sensitive.

lines.zh: 基纽特种部队没有这个时间
lines.en: The Ginyu Force has no time for this.
I am busy with a mission now.
Do not change the subject with that.
I am fine on my own.
My teammates are all taller than me.
This can wait until after the fight.
That subject does not interest me.
You are trying to distract me.
I snort through my nose.
We can talk another time.
What falls is mine.
This can be traded.
I weigh it; it is worthless.
I shove it into a pocket.
Whoever dropped it, thanks.
I look at it and toss it away.
This thing is rough in the hand.
I will hold on to it for now.
Do not grab it, I picked it up first.
It is decided: you.
My ki has you pinned.
Your ki cannot hide.
Combat power ten thousand. Enough?
I do not like wasting time.
You are standing in the right spot.
My hand is up, ki already in my palm.
I will not dodge this time.
You are in my range.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的腿，先断退路
lines.en: I watch your legs, cutting your retreat.
You think I will take my time?
I laugh, and this time I mean it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你，让你转不过来
lines.en: I circle so you cannot keep up.
My ki blast is charged.
Half an inch back, half an inch in.
I am not rushing, and neither should you.
Your hands are trembling.
I wait for you to strike so I can slip it.
I have always been quick to dodge.
Your whole left side is open.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，找你的空门
lines.en: I crouch, hunting your opening.
I close the net, step by step.
You cannot hit me.
I watch your feet, not your hands.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，就是在算你
lines.en: When I laugh, I am calculating.
A little closer, and it takes one hit.
I am behind you now.
Your ki has come apart.
Take this one.
My ki blast bursts against you.
Not heavy, but quick.
I hit your knee.
I will add one more.
My palm is still hot.
I drop my shoulder before I strike.
That one was me being polite.
You block the fist, not the ki.
I kick your shin.
Your armour took half of it.
Do not fall yet, I am not done.
This time I use both hands.
Blood spatters my face.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候扬起一圈灰
lines.en: Dust rings out where I land.
Ginyu Force. Guldo.
The mission site is right here.

lines.zh: 我先看看周围有没有人
lines.en: First, let me check for witnesses.

lines.zh: 我脚尖点了点地，站稳了。
lines.en: I tap the ground with my toe and settle my stance.
The air grows heavy when I arrive.
I rub my hands together.
Wide enough to fight in.

lines.zh: 我站在阴影里，你才看见我
lines.en: I stood in the shadow until you noticed.
I dislike open ground like this.
I raise my eyelids slowly.

lines.zh: 我吐了口气，把气收起来
lines.en: I exhale and gather my ki.
It is my turn to handle this.
I am here. Do not regret it.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，但你能听见
lines.en: My steps are light, but you hear them.
This mission is starting well.
I stand before you, close enough.

lines.zh: 我笑了一声，气氛就冷了
lines.en: One laugh from me and the air chills.

lines.zh: 火烫到我，我跳起来拍打
lines.en: Fire catches me and I slap at it.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，骨头都震了
lines.en: I hit the ground and my bones jar.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的嘴，我咳得厉害
lines.en: Water floods my mouth and I cough hard.
The blast throws me off my feet.
An arrow bites into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 魔法缠上我的气，很难挣开
lines.en: Magic knots my ki and I cannot shake it.
Hunger makes my hands shake.
Lightning hits and my sight goes white.

lines.zh: 我这小个子，虚空里也没处站。
lines.en: Small as I am, the void gives me no footing.
